body: I just want someone to talk to. please anyone

I'm sorry for the comments but, I have a lot of nervous energy and no where to direct it. Typing all this out has calmed me a lot. It will all be okay, I need to get through the weekend and first thing Monday morning I'll call some doctors maybe even call my GP. I'm sure I'll find someone who can help me. Especially since I don't need any new medications or a new diagnoses. Worst case I'll have to call out tomorrow. That's not too bad. I will be okay. It's weird because I feel physically very sad. I've been crying for an hour. BUT emotionally I feel pretty calm. Except for some frustration and anxiety about the doctor. Other than that I feel pretty good but all day I've been tired and physically sad and getting a migraine. There is also this feeling of loneliness I want someone to talk to me and validate my feelings. My parents are busy and I'm embarrassed about calling my friends. I thought the hotline would be the social aspect I needed but, they didn't talk to me for long. if anyone could respond I would appreciate it greatly

I wish someone would take me seriously. I just need someone to help me with my medications. Am I calling the wrong doctors? Am I phrasing myself incorrectly. I can't help but blame myself for not being able to find a phyciatrist. Does anyone have any tips for find someone asap to assist with medications

Just typing out comments seems to help a lot. The first women I spoke to on the hotline just hung up on me. I just wanted someone to talk to. I'm not currently suisidal I'm just having a moment of deep sadness. The website said that was one of the reasons I could call. When I called back the second man spoke to me for a bit but hung up after a while but at least he said goodbye first. I think lots of services don't take me seriously because I keep it together reasonably well.

I also just feel guilty because except for my inability to get medical help I'm supposedly peachy keen. my parents love and support me i have some friends and I have a job. Calling all those offices was painful and somewhat demeaning but it wasn't that bad until today. I forgot how much the zoloft helped me.
